assessments.reasoning: The IEC abstract for the identified 2024 edition expressly covers program representation, syntax, constraints and semantic interpretation. It separately excludes the mechanisms for preparing a program for use on a system and for invoking it. The claim accurately reports selected matters from the abstract without treating the list as exhaustive.

challenge.method: Read the complete abstract in context and test whether translation was being confused with input or output conversion, whether invocation was a separate exclusion, and whether any capture changed the polarity or narrowed either exclusion.
challenge.results: The first two exclusions concern programs themselves. Later exclusions address input and output data separately. Both program mechanisms fall under the same explicit exclusion in all three bodies. The claim preserves the distinction between covered language rules and excluded mechanisms.

limitations: The catalog abstract establishes its own coverage and exclusions. Technical clauses and implementation behavior require their own evidence.
